<!-- pr-reviewer: 9c3d2888e36611daea6f02720cf79d3c440350bf -->
**Second read (SAFETY tier, Opus). Verdict: clean. The PR now conflicts with `main`, so the label is `conflicts`, not `merge-ready`.**

This review is the second read of head `9c3d2888e`. The first review of this head was clean. The PR changes posted G-code (F words on Fanuc, Doosan DNM and Mazak). Thus the safety floor applies, and this read uses the `effort:high` model.

### Merge state

- I built and tested a trial merge of the head with upstream main `29bb9e9a2`. That merge was clean, and all of the steps below ran on it.
- After that, `main` merged #3801 (`56d1eff4b`, program-end rotary return). Now `crates/post/tests/doosan_dnm_post.rs` conflicts. NeoTech set `conflicts` for this reason.
- The conflict is in one assertion of `doosan_dnm_index_names_only_a_stated_rotary`. #3801 added `"M11", "G00 A0.", "M10"` to the move list. This PR changed `F400` to `F400.`. The resolved line must have the two changes: `... "G01 X50. Y0. Z-1. F400.", "M11", "G00 A0.", "M10"`.
- #3801 also changed Fanuc and Doosan DNM goldens. Git merges `examples/catalog/multiaxis/indexed/indexed.nc` without a conflict. After the refresh, run the quick gate again. The author must confirm that the merged goldens agree with the post output.
- Required work: merge `origin/main` into the branch. Do not rebase. Then run the quick gate, push, and write "ready for a re-check". The code review stays valid for this head.

### What I checked

1. **The post change.** `ff()` in the three posts now returns `pt(...)`. `pt()` adds a point only when the word has no point. Thus `F2` becomes `F2.`, and `F0.25` or `F12.5` do not change. The capped rotary path (`rotaryFeedWord`, `crates/post/src/post/rotary_cap.rs:150`) returns `"F<n>"` or `""`. The post refuses an empty word before it calls `pt()`. Precision, conversion, rounding and the rate caps do not change.
2. **Other F writers.** The G84 tap feed (`tapFeed`, from #3699 on `main`) already writes `pt(fn(v))`. I found no other F writer in the three posts. These posts do not write G93. `ff()` still returns `"0"` for a feed that is not positive. That is not a scaling problem, because zero is zero in all units.
3. **Moved goldens, line by line.** A script read the `-U0` diff of each of the 97 changed `.nc` files. It added a point to each unpointed F word on each removed line, then compared the result with the added line. Result: 97 files, 27,691 points added, 0 other differences. This agrees with the "Goldens moved" table in the body.
4. **The control manual notes** (`docs/decisions/3690-feed-decimals.md`):
   - Fanuc and Doosan DNM: the record cites FANUC B-64604EN-2/01 (0i-F mill), section 5.2.1, and B-63784EN/01 (15i), section 5.3. These give an unpointed inch F a unit of 0.01 inch/min. The 15i F41 parameter can also scale a metric F. A pointed F word always means the stated unit. Thus `F2.` and `F500.` are correct on each Fanuc-family control, and the point cannot make a correct feed wrong.
   - Mazak: MAZATROL MATRIX EIA/ISO, sections 7-2 and 7-3. An unpointed metric F is whole mm/min, and an unpointed inch F is 0.01 inch/min. The point makes the two units explicit. The fix agrees with the manual note.
   - The Doosan source is the 0i-F manual, which is the FANUC control of that machine family. This agrees with the post header.
   - I did not open the PDFs again. This host could not download them during the review. I compared the record with the cited sections and with the existing Haas rule (#3681) and the length-word rule (#1836) in `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`. They are the same type of rule.
   - The "Keep" rows for the 14 other posts each name a manual example that shows an unpointed F in the stated unit. These posts are not changed.
5. **Laws** (upstream `main` `AGENTS.md`):
   - No `unwrap` or `expect` is added outside tests. No panic is added.
   - The new top-level binary `crates/post/tests/control_feed_decimal_point.rs` has its reason in the body. `camcraft-post` has no directory suite (no `crates/post/tests/*/main.rs`). Thus the rule **New tests join a directory suite** is satisfied.
   - The test file has a provenance line and a Gate map.
   - The decision record is present. The `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #3690` are present.
   - No UI code changed, so no screenshots are necessary.
   - No process file, script, `.github`, `build.rs` or dependency changed.
   - The issue is `P3`. Thus no targeted heavy step is necessary (rule **Heavy lanes at review**).

### Build and tests (local, trial merge with `29bb9e9a2`)

- Post suites (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only "post"`): 141 steps, 0 failed. This includes `control_feed_decimal_point` (5 passed), `comp`, `fanuc_post`, `doosan_dnm_post`, `tap_feed_mill_posts`, `wcs_flip_dialects` and the recorded goldens.
- App suites in the quick plan: 695 binaries, 0 failed. The gate ran 274 steps and stopped at the host time limit, with 0 failures. I ran the other 421 binaries by name with `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-fail-fast`. All 421 passed.
- `ui suites: lib`: passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`): 6 steps, 0 failed.

**Extra suites run**

- `app suites: example_catalog`: 39 passed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed. `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- Golden suites: `golden_cl`, `conformance`, `posting`, `program_entry`, `recorded_post_streams`, `wcs_flip_post`, `predrilled_entry`, `rotary_feed_cap`: all passed.
- No file under `testdata/` changed, and no importer code changed. Thus no kernel suites are necessary.

### Mutations (I ran these myself)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Fanuc capped feed: `return pt(word)` changed to `return word` | `fanuc_capped_inch_feed_keeps_its_decimal_point` red (`... A90. F1`) |
| Mazak `ff()`: `pt(...)` removed | `mazak_whole_inch_feeds_keep_their_decimal_point` red (`expected unscaled F2.`) |
| Both restored | 5 of 5 green |

The other pins stayed green under each mutation. This shows that each pin finds only its own path.

### Findings

None blocking.

### Optional, non-blocking

- `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`, rule "A length word carries its decimal point (#1836)": the text names the Haas feed point (#3681) only. You can add one sentence for the Fanuc, Doosan DNM and Mazak feed point (#3690). Suggested follow-up: `P7`.

### Heavy lanes

These were not run at review. Upstream `AGENTS.md` (**Heavy lanes at review**, #3556) does not require them for a `P3` PR. The body reports a heavy run on this head against `7868d3786`: 61 of 62 steps passed. The `--failed` retry passed all 3 selected steps.

Merged upstream main to resolve the conflict. The assertion keeps both changes: `F400.` and the `M11`, `G00 A0.`, `M10` return sequence.

- Pin: `doosan_dnm_index_names_only_a_stated_rotary`. Removing the feed point makes it RED. Disabling the rotary return makes it RED. Each restoration makes it GREEN.
- Merged goldens: `conformance::every_builtin_posts_every_golden_byte_exact` passed. Indexed catalog `regenerates`, `rebuilds`, and `posts_two_single_axis_indexes_and_one_tilted_pocket` passed. The Doosan, Fanuc, and Mazak recorded suites passed.
- Clippy passed for `camcraft-post` and `camcraft-app`, with all targets and warnings denied.
- Quick gate: RED. 838 of 839 selected steps passed across the initial run and retry. The UI library had 1,535 passes, seven failures, and eight ignored tests. All seven failures report unavailable GPU adapters. Metal found no adapters. No UI source changed.

The dependency metadata errors cleared after a local cache repair. No logs or review evidence are committed.

New head: `1e0fb2176b7c895bc69ea27dfff8d1a4377b1eaa`.
The PR stays a draft. The warm worktree remains in place.
